bullets: GC reported no incidents or near misses; fall protection toolbox talk held 08/27.

The site fence along Hollis Street was pushed in by a delivery truck on 08/28 and repaired the same day. GC will station a flagger for any Hollis Street delivery exceeding thirty minutes because apparatus responds from that side.

GC reported Merrimack Steel has moved structural steel delivery from 10/05 to 10/19, a two-week slip on the addition. GC expects to recover part of the slip by re-sequencing interior work in the existing bay and will submit a revised baseline schedule by 09/04 (Item 1.01).
Owner reiterated that contractual substantial completion of 03/15/2027 stands. GC is not requesting additional time at this point.
PCO 001, additional asbestos abatement at the mezzanine, is approved at $11,400 and will be carried on Change Order 01.

Ledge was encountered on the gridline C footing line approximately two feet above the boring elevations. GC estimates three days of hoe-ram work and trucking, rough order of magnitude $15,000–$18,000; a PCO with T&M tickets will follow.

RFI 007 (footing elevation at gridline C) is with Ridgeway's structural engineer. The response is required before the C-line footing pour, planned for the week of 09/14; Ridgeway to respond by 09/11 (Item 1.02).
The switchgear submittal is approved. The vendor is quoting a 20–24 week lead time; GC to provide a vendor letter with a firm ship date by 09/08 (Item 1.03).
Generator resubmittal No. 2 was submitted 08/31. Architect will return it within ten working days per the specification.
ASI 03 (kitchen casework revisions requested by the Fire Department: taller upper cabinets and a second sink) is in progress; Ridgeway to issue by 09/08 (Item 1.04).
Selective demolition in the existing building is complete except the mezzanine, which is pending abatement clearance expected 09/02.
Underground plumbing in the addition is approximately 70% complete. Footings at gridlines A and B are poured; gridline C is held for ledge removal.
Two-week look-ahead: complete underground plumbing, form and pour C-line footings pending RFI 007, start CMU at the elevator shaft.
The Building Inspector passed the gridline A and B footing inspections.
The Hollis Street water tap must be performed by Town DPW. GC to submit a formal tap request to DPW this week and coordinate a date (Item 1.05); Owner will support scheduling once dates are provided.
Chief Benson will review the three apparatus bay paint options with the shift captains and make a selection by 09/15 (Item 1.06).

Engine 2 must be relocated before existing bay slab demolition, scheduled for the week of 09/21. Chief expects to house Engine 2 at Station 2 pending confirmation of mutual aid coverage; to be confirmed at the next meeting.
The NorthStar Cx commissioning agent contract is with Town Counsel. OPM to have it executed by 09/18 so that mechanical submittal reviews can begin (Item 1.07).

decisions: Owner authorized ledge removal at gridline C on a time-and-materials basis, not to exceed $18,500, funded from Owner's contingency and processed as a change order; T&M tickets to be signed daily by the OPM's field representative.
